confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Naples prices. The price sources were crowd-sourced aggregates summarised in search results (Numbeo via Expatica, Numbeo's Naples page and CityCost). They put a cappuccino at about EUR 2.02-2.10, a meal at an inexpensive restaurant at about EUR 15.6 (range EUR 10-26) and domestic draft beer at about EUR 5.0-5.2. These were converted to USD at about 1.10 USD per EUR, implied by the RBA USD and EUR cross rates for 18 Nov 2026. The mid-range meal for two (about EUR 60) is a model estimate, because the sources found disagreed or looked implausible. The cocktail (about EUR 9) and glass of wine (about EUR 5) were not seen directly. They are based on local price relationships to beer and general knowledge, so they are less certain. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July high season, with no booking pages or listings checked. July demand in Naples, driven by Amalfi and Capri transit, adds uncertainty. Prices in tourist areas of the historic centre and waterfront may be higher.
comparable_city_reasoning: Naples-specific crowd-sourced food and drink averages were used directly. Accommodation was calibrated against southern Italian and Mediterranean tourist cities such as Palermo and Bari in peak summer, with a premium for Naples' role as a gateway to Amalfi and Capri.
